channel.title: Daily brief - Martin Jordanovski
channel.description: AI, technology and software development news, summarised every morning. Leadership, psychology and investing on Mondays.

item.title: Daily brief, 25 Nov 2026
item.description:
Tidal to ban fully AI-generated music from December 9: Tidal will stop allowing fully AI-generated music on December 9 and will delete roughly 27 to 29 million such tracks. It expects to reject about 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day, while still accepting AI-assisted songs.
Java4Shell: Oracle and OpenJDK ship fixes for a HotSpot Base64 decoder flaw: Oracle and the OpenJDK project released fixes on November 17 for CVE-2026-114938, a memory corruption bug in the HotSpot JVM's Base64 decoder. JetBrains is urging users to update its IDEs and related tools.
Microsoft declares internal 'Code Red' after nearly 24-hour Outlook outage: Microsoft has declared an unusual internal 'Code Red' after a nearly 24-hour Exchange Online and Outlook outage this month. A bug on Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers took email down for millions of customers.
